claims.claim: Run on 2026-10-03 with workflows/api/img_edit_qwen.json's model (Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 fp8, 20 steps, cfg 4, denoise 1.0) on a clay render of HFL_F_NKD_Body_A with head A, at the owner's request: (1) a text instruction to make the figure slender kept the pose and aged the face and body, at seeds 0 and 1 (160 s and 147 s); (2) DWPose on the render (DWPreprocessor from comfyui_controlnet_aux, 1024 px) as image 2 and the bodysuit concept qwenfast_00017_ as image 1 posed the concept to the skeleton and drew a child, at both seeds (233 s, 227 s), and again with adult wording in the prompt and a negative prompt against childlike features; no mesh was made from these; (3) with no skeleton, the clay render as image 2 made the output copy the render's body in the concept's colours (248 s); (4) a text-only instruction on qwenfast_00017_ to lower the arms about 30 degrees and bring the feet to hip width kept the face, build and proportions and lowered the arms, with the feet still wide (152 s).
